title: Prescribed lifts of 2-dimensional representations
summary: Let F be a totally real field, and let p be prime. Under standard Taylor--Wiles hypotheses, we show that an irreducible, 2-dimensional, totally odd mod p representation of the absolute Galois group of F admits lifts lying on arbitrary prescribed components of local deformation rings, allowing potentially semistable conditions with arbitrary regular Hodge--Tate weights.
